The following events took place in '''30,500 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*A [[Asteroid/Legends|meteor]] crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], forming a crater. Millennia later, the crater would fill with [[Water/Legends|water]] from the local aquifers and form a [[Aldera lake|lake]] over which the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] would be built. {{Circa}}<ref name="FF18">According to [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 18|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 18]], the crater on which [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] was built formed roughly three thousands [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the arrival of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places around [[27,500 BBY]].</ref>
